summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia filed a Form 6-K to notify shareholders of a cash dividend payment. The Board of Directors resolved on June 30, 2026, to distribute Ps. 39,999,772,000 in three equal installments of Ps. 13,333,257,333.33 each, payable between July and September 2026. The second installment corresponds to Ps. 8.30084132575421 per share (830% of par value) for shareholders of record on August 3, 2026, with payment beginning August 6, 2026. A 7% withholding tax applies under Argentine law. The dividend is a routine capital return, not a special situation. No further action or risk-arb angle exists; this is a standard distribution.
